item.title: Reliance Industries reports 25% revenue growth in Q4
item.description: Reliance Industries Ltd reported strong Q4 earnings with revenue up 25% year-over-year. The company announced record profits and increased dividend to shareholders.
item.content:encoded: Full article content about Reliance Industries Q4 earnings showing strong performance across all business segments

item.title: TCS wins major $1 billion contract from US technology client
item.description: Tata Consultancy Services announced a $1 billion contract win from a large US-based technology client. This contract is expected to boost revenues in the coming fiscal year.

item.title: HDFC Bank reports steady loan growth amid market volatility
item.description: HDFC Bank announced strong loan growth in Q4 despite market uncertainties. The bank's NPA ratios remain healthy and deposits grew steadily.

item.title: Wipro faces challenges in IT services market
item.description: Wipro reported mixed results for the quarter with client pressure in the BFSI segment. The company announced cost optimization measures to improve margins.

item.title: Infosys Q4 earnings beat analyst expectations
item.description: Infosys posted strong Q4 results beating analyst estimates with robust revenue growth and improved operating margins. Management guided for continued growth momentum.
